page.title: Edit profile
page.userContext: A person updates a display name and biography in a compact or desktop viewport.
assumptions: The curated example saves only in-memory session state; the interface says so.

intents.goal: Edit profile text and acknowledge the saved session state.
intents.successSignal: Saved for this session appears after saving and clears when editing resumes.

information.content: Display name, biography, character count and save status.
information.placement: Labeled scrollable fields between navigation and bottom save action.
information.visibility: Fields always; save status only after saving.

reuse.rationale: Catalog search found existing controls; a shared scaffold supplies missing page geometry and system bar ownership.

interactions.trigger: Edit text and activate Save profile.

feedback.immediate: Button acknowledges activation and dismisses the keyboard.
feedback.recovery: Edit again; data remains local to the session.

bestPractices.decision: Use shared editing behavior and a keyboard-safe bottom action; fields scroll independently of navigation.
bestPractices.evidence: scaffold_test.dart and text_editing_test.dart cover keyboard, safe area and platform gesture behavior.

expected: Saved for this session is announced.
